description: A utility class for generating formatted code snippets with proper indentation in C#. It provides methods to manage indentation levels and append text or lines to an internal string builder.

classes.name: CodeStringBuilder
classes.description: Helper class for building code strings with indentation, providing methods to control indentation levels and append text or lines.

methods.name: Indent
methods.description: Increments the indentation level and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: Outdent
methods.description: Decrements the indentation level if greater than zero and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a string to the internal StringBuilder and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: AppendLine
methods.description: Appends a line with current indentation; if text is provided, prepends indentation before appending.
